scope: Development-scale common tandem environment; fixed round-robin telemetry, unlimited buffers, uniform replay, joint Double DQN using PRORL network and learning functions. No expert, native transfer actions, or native pretrained weights.
train_trace_rule: 910000 + episode (zero-based); cycle scenarios; shared across training seeds
validation_trace_rule: 920000 + scenario index; one trace per scenario
selection: minimum mean validation total cost; earliest checkpoint on ties; no test tuning
actions: 4 transport capacities x 4 compute capacities x 19 shares
network: fully connected 32 ReLU units, no batch normalization
reward: negative sum over five slots of (outstanding packets at slot end / 20 + active extra units / 5 + absolute capacity change / 20)
optimizer: Adam 0.001, gamma 0.97, batch 32, uniform replay 2048, one update per decision after warmup of 32, target sync every 80 decisions
endpoints: mature packet deadline miss count and denominator
analysis: Average within each scenario over 5 paired traces, then across the 5 trained policies. Fixed policies evaluated once per trace. Descriptive only.
